name: sleep-screensaver
description: Stream Deck plugin to put your Mac or PC to sleep or start the screensaver

scripts.build: STREAM_DECK_VARIANT=prod rollup -c && STREAM_DECK_VARIANT=prod node tools/prepare-manifest.mjs && npm install --production --prefix com.whyisjake.sleep-screensaver.sdPlugin
scripts.build:dev: STREAM_DECK_VARIANT=dev rollup -c && STREAM_DECK_VARIANT=dev node tools/prepare-manifest.mjs && npm install --production --prefix com.whyisjake.sleep-screensaver.dev.sdPlugin
scripts.build:dev:restart: npm run build:dev && npm run link:dev && node tools/restart-stream-deck.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.whyisjake.sleep-screensaver.sdPlugin && ls -lh *.streamDeckPlugin

author: whyisjake
